name: Portland
lede: Rainy, woodsy, and obsessed with discs — Portland's courses thread through 200-foot Douglas firs and state-park forests. We're publishing the metro's best first.
introParagraphs: Portland is a disc golf city the way it's a coffee city: seriously, and from the ground up. Pier Park is the beloved free classic — 18 par 3s winding through towering firs in St. Johns — while Milo McIver in Estacada is the tournament cathedral that hosts the Beaver State Fling. Both are among the most-played and best-loved courses in the Pacific Northwest.

The pay-to-play gems are worth the drive: Blue Lake's marathon 10,000-foot layout and Horning's Hideout, the private three-course property with camping. Rain is part of the deal — grippy shoes are standard equipment. The Eastside Disc Golf Divas and Disc Golf or Die clubs run weekly leagues, and the community is famously welcoming to newcomers.

New here? Pier Park is the essential first round; Milo McIver is the pilgrimage. For gear, All Day Disc Golf in Portland is the dedicated pro shop, and Next Adventure on SE Grand carries a solid disc selection alongside outdoor gear.

faqs.question: How many disc golf courses are in the Portland metro?
faqs.answer: There are 39 courses across the Portland metro, mapped and live on FindFrolf, with more added every week.

faqs.question: What's the best disc golf course in Portland?
faqs.answer: Tied at the top: Pier Park, the free St. Johns classic through 200-foot Douglas firs, and Milo McIver, the tournament course in Estacada that hosts the Beaver State Fling.

faqs.question: Are Portland's disc golf courses free?
faqs.answer: Most are. 28 of the 39 mapped courses are free to play, and 11 are pay-to-play. Check each course page for its current green fee.

faqs.question: What's the best beginner course in Portland?
faqs.answer: Pier Park — all par 3s, walkable, free, and forgiving enough to learn on while the firs teach you lines. Hudson Park is another gentle option.

faqs.question: Where can I buy disc golf gear in Portland?
faqs.answer: All Day Disc Golf is the dedicated pro shop. Next Adventure on SE Grand carries discs alongside outdoor gear. Play It Again Sports has new and used options.
